title: Implement compatible searchable-truth projection

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Searchable projection tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_searchable_projection.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#compatible-searchable-truth RED: no owner projection distinguishes complete compatible searchable state from persisted ready alone; GREEN: the matrix returns true only for active current-revision ready with both derivatives and a valid face and false for every inactive, incompatible, incomplete and non-ready case; decisive comparison: exact row/projection membership matches the contract without a cosine query or foreign write; artifact: focused database projection matrix.
purpose: Publish the processing-owned facts needed to decide whether one Photo is currently eligible for compatible exact search.
success_outcome: Only active complete ready state for the selected serving revision projects searchable=true; every incompatible, inactive or incomplete case remains explicit and false.
anti_goals: Do not implement cosine query execution, search ranking, result assembly or serving-setting mutation.
Do not write inventory visibility or serving-control state from processing.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: Truthful eligibility cannot be expressed through existing inventory and serving projections.
The result would require processing to write foreign owner state or implement FT-004 query behavior.

constraints: Read immutable Photo visibility and selected-revision projections through accepted boundaries.
Publish processing state/face facts only; inventory composes the staff-visible result.
Use deterministic rows and no realtime query execution.
invariants: ready alone is insufficient without active Photo, both derivatives, at least one valid face and current revision.
Other revisions and pending, processing, no_faces or failed are never searchable.
Neither consumer writes another owner's state.
verification_targets: Matrix covers active/current complete ready plus inactive, incompatible, missing-derivative, missing-face and every non-ready state.
